tools.name: kr_check_business__number
tools.description: Check the format and check digit of a Korean business registration number (사업자등록번호, 10 digits) or corporate registration number (법인등록번호, 13 digits). Does not check whether the business is active or closed.

tools.name: kr_amount_in_words
tools.description: Write an amount in Korean won as words: formal (계약서·영수증 style, e.g. 금 일백이십삼만사천오백원정) and plain (e.g. 백이십삼만 사천오백 원).

tools.name: kr_normalize_phone
tools.description: Normalize a Korean phone number to display form (010-1234-5678, 02-123-4567, 1588-1234) and E.164 (+821012345678), and tell its kind (mobile, Seoul, area code, nationwide 15xx/16xx/18xx, internet 070).
